guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice latency-90 rose from 0.0046 to 0.2125 (z=+899) and latency-50 rose 1334%, the largest deviations in the digest, while emailservice CPU is flat (+3.9%) and no memory, socket or workload anomaly appears. checkoutservice, its caller in the service map, shows a smaller latency rise (p90 +106%), consistent with propagation from emailservice; frontend latency is barely changed.

proposed_fix.description: Investigate network delay on emailservice (pod/node network path, e.g. injected latency or a degraded link) and its calls from checkoutservice, and restore normal network conditions or restart/reschedule the emailservice pod if a delay fault is confirmed. Non-destructive checks first.
